v2.feedback: The mirror-flip Narcissus concept is strong and the dual-palette (warm real / cool reflection) is tastefully restrained. However, DESIRED=2 with camera at z=48 likely makes the fox far too small in frame — scale the model to at least 14-18 units or pull the camera to z=22 so particles fill >30% of the viewport. The boids flocking on 60k particles risks both GPU stall and silhouette dissolution; consider reducing to 35k particles with stronger home-position spring (0.03+ instead of 0.015) to keep the fox legible while the boids add life rather than scatter. Finally, add a fallback sphere-sampling path if the GLB fetch fails so the piece never renders blank.
